_meta.dataset: UK healthcare and allied-health course universe for Nigerian applicants (master taxonomy)
_meta.method: Seeded from research 02, 03 and 05 (SERP observation, WebSearch snippets) and regulator names from general professional knowledge marked 'confirm'. Every value is unverified until read on the official page. Statuses use the SEO decision-engine vocabulary (docs/seo/DECISION-ENGINE.md §3) and decide whether a public page may exist; RESEARCH and REJECTED subjects never get an indexable page. §B (availability, A-levels, fees, English) comes from a 60-search snippet sweep labelled FACT (official page snippet) / LEAD (aggregator) / NOT FOUND; nothing is inferred across universities or professions; every value is VERIFY-ON-PAGE until read on the official page and recorded as a reference_fact.
_meta.wikipedia_policy: Wikipedia may be used to discover subjects, terminology and institutions; never as the sole authority for requirements, fees, deadlines, immigration, registration or availability.
